(275)༄༅/ /ar+ya dzam bha la'i rjes gnang bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (275)༄༅// ar+ya dzam bha la'i rjes gnang bzhugs so//

(276) ༄༅// chos sku skye ba med pa'i nam mkha' la// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i sprin chen cher 'khrigs nas// sprul sku mchog gis dngos grub char chen 'bebs// sku gsum lhun grub dzam bha lha la 'dud// 'dir rje btsun dzam bha lha la'i rjes gnang 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ bkod pa bshams pa dang*/ mngon rtogs bsgoms nas bdag 'jug blangs pa'o// dang po bkod pa bshams pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba ser po/ phyogs bzhir phyogs mdog /mtshams bzhir mdzes tshon// 'dab ma brgyad la nor bu re re bri/ mtha' la mchod gtor gyis bskor/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i las bum yang bshams/ gzhan yang rjes gnang la mkho ba'i rdzas rnams kyang tshogs par bsham mo// gnyis bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gdan la/ kha shar du bltas te 'dug la thog mar skyabs 'gro sems skyed yan lag bdun pa/ tshad med pa bzhi sogs rnams ni spyi dang mthun no// bye brag / swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu nor bu rin po che du ma las grub pa'i khri/ bum bsnol gyis brgyan pa'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa'i steng du bī dza pu ra dzaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dzam bha la sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs can/ gser gyi sku rags la lte ba nor bus mtshan pa bcings pa/ gsus khyim che zhing yan lag dang lhu tshigs rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas pas mchod sbyin pus mo'i steng du mdzad nas/ shing thog pañtsa pu ra ka'i lte ba yid (277)bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa 'dzin pa/

g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa/ zhal cung zad khro zhing yid tsam 'dzum pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar rab tu rgyas pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog gyen la bcings shing lhag ma mthur du 'phyang ba/ me tog gi phreng bas skra chings dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'od 'bar ba lnga'i rtse phran gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che du mas snyan cha dang mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan dang phyag gdub/ rked rgyan dang zhabs gdub/ rin pa che dang ut+pal sngon pos do shal dang chun pos brgyan pa/ mu tig sna lnga'i phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lcang lo can nas rang lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la dbyer med du bstim/ slar 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib dag /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin 'byung la sogs rigs lngas bu brgyan par bsam/ snying khar pad zla'i steng du nor bu 'od 'bar ba'i lte ba dzaṃ gyis mtshan pa la sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod la phog gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud la phog dzaṃ bha lar gyur/ tshur 'dus rang la thim/ thugs kar 'khor bar bsam/ 'od zer gyi rtse na gnas pa'i dzaṃ bha la rnams kyis rin po che sna lnga'i char phab par bsam la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// de nas mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du yang*/ bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin du dzaṃ bha la bskyed la/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab bo// las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gzhung bzhin (278)bskyed la dbang bskur rgyas gdab spyi dang mthun/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed gnyis kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar 'khor zhing thugs rgyud bskul bas/ sngags gsungs shing sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ bsnyen pa brgya stong la sogs bskyal/ slar de dag la mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma phul la 'dod don du gsol ba gdab/ de nas skabs 'dir yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pas/ rang ting nge 'dzin gyis bdag 'jug blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ slob ma rnams las bum gyi chus khrus byas/ gral la 'khod de/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ thal mo sbyor la nga'i rjes zlos cig ces brjod la/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum gyi skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa byin/ de nas sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum gyis sems bskyed kyi sdom pa bzung ngo*// de nas yan lag bdun (279)pa bya ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid// bla ma dzaṃ bha la phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo//

zhes lan gsum bya'o// de dag gis sngon 'gro rnams song nas// gnyis pa dngos gzhi lnga ste/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang lnga'o// dang po sku'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai/ ston pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag dzaṃ bha la// bdag cag 'khor bas 'jigs shing thugs rjes bzung du gsol// mun par gyur pa'i 'gro ba'i grong khyer na// 'jigs shing ya nga khyod la gsol ba 'debs// bde ba chen po mya ngan 'das pa'i grong*// zhabs kyi rdul la reg cing rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab// de nas slob dpon gyis gnang ba sbyin pa ni// bdag gi thugs rje'i nyi ma yi// 'od kyis ma rig mun pa bsal// khyed kyi lus ngag yid gsum la// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab// zhes pa brjod do// de nas slob ma rnams las bum gyis chus bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs nas/ dzaṃ bha la mngon rtogs nas byung ba ltar bskyed la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tha dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la phog pas/ thams cad dzaṃ bha la'i rnam pa sku chung la yan lag rag pa/ phyag mtshan gsal ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ bla ma'i sku las kyang dzaṃ bha la'i sku dpag tu med pa chad nas byung bas/ (280)me tog 'di dang gnyis su med pa slob ma'i lus la mtsho la kha babs pa ltar sib sib thim par bsgom la/ me tog gtor/ spos dang rol mo dkrol/ slob ma'i spyi bor sku bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de ltar sku'i rjes gnang gi phan yon la/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug tu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i dzaṃ bha la'i sku thob pa'i dgos pa yod de/

zhes brjod do// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang zhu ba yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gong bzhin btab la/ de nas dpon slob gnyis ka dzam bha lar bskyed pa'i snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ ser po la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas sngags phreng gser zhun ma lta bu'i phreng ba nar gyis thon nas/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying pa'i dzaṃ yig la 'khor bar dmigs la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du phreng ba la bzung la rjes zlos byed du gzhug /de nas phreng ba slob ma'i mgrin par reg ste/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan rigs sngags 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ 'di la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis las/ gnas skabs su sngags kyi nus pa che zhing ngag gi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa dang*/ mthar thug tu gang bden pa'i tshig 'grub cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang (281)zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gong ltar btab/ de nas slob ma lus rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ bdun gyi nam mkhar dzaṃ ser po gser gyi mdog can zhig bsam/ de nas rang gi lus 'ja' lus su yal nas/ mdun gyi dzaṃ yig la thim pa la rig pa gtad cing*/ dzaṃ yig kyang nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam zhing sems stong gsal nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// 'di la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon gnyis te// gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyed ba dang*/ mthar thug tu chos nyid ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i dgos pa yod do// bzhi pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul

la gsol ba gong bzhin btab/ de nas slob ma dzaṃ bha lar bskyed du bcug la/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yas su nor bu gtad la/ 'di 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la'i phyag mtshan yid bzhin gyi nor bu ste/ bsam don thams cad chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// lag pa g.yon du ne'u le gtad la/ 'dir ār+ya dzaṃ bha la'i phyag mtshan ne'u le yin te/ 'di 'chang ba tsam gyis dgos 'dod char ltar du 'bab par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// 'di'i phan yon la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan mtha' dag thob par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// lnga pa phrin las kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i (282)yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gong bzhin btab/ de nas/ slob ma dzaṃ bha lar bskyed pa'i yan lag lnga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i yan lag lnga nor bur bskyed pa ni/ spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu dkar po/ phrag pa g.yas par dmar po/ g.yon par sngon po/ dpyi mgo g.yas su ser po/ g.yon du ljang khu 'od 'bar ba lnga las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs dang*/ stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rnams dang*/ gtsug na rin chen la sogs klu chen po brgyad kyi longs spyod dang*/ snod bcud kyi zas nor thams cad nor bu'i rnam pa can du 'dus nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i gnas lnga'i nor bu la thim/ nor bu de dag las nor bu rigs lnga mang po 'phros nas slob ma'i nor bu la thim pas longs spyod char ltar bab par bsgoms shig / ces brjod la/ nor bu gnas lngar gtugs shig / nor bu 'di lngas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par 'gyur zhing dgos 'dod char ltar du 'bab par 'gyur ro//

zhes brjod do// 'di dag phan yon ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ gnas skabs su phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'grub cing sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do// zhes brjod la/ bla ma la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ deng nas bzung ste khyod bran du// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa rjes ni/ gtang rag gi mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// de nas bkra shis brjod do// ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bcom ldan dzam bha lha'i rjes gnang rim pa 'di// bla ma'i zhal nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin// nor 'khrul med pa 'od dpag rdo rjes bkod// dge bas 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog// /sarba dā ka l+yā ṇa bha ba tu/
